name: Goodbye Fantasy
source:
Saying goodnight, then disappearing...
A wolfman tries to understand what happened with his friend Alma as he uncovers secrets from the Applegate School and the new students who appeared suddenly.

[From [url=https://ishatee1.itch.io/goodbye-fantasy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
说了声晚安，就消失了……
狼人试图了解他的朋友阿尔玛发生了什么事，同时揭开了阿普尔盖特学校和突然出现的新生的秘密。

[来自[url=https://ishatee1.itch.io/goodbye-fantasy]Itch.io[/url]]
